transcript_only_text:
So most business owners think that they
own a business, when in reality they own a very expensive, high-paying job.
Investors don't buy businesses that can't survive without the founder. So it
doesn't matter how much revenue you do, if every decision, you know, comes from
you, every client and every fire comes back to you, the value of the business
is close to zero. And it's something that we call key man risk. And so until
you solve it, you don't have an asset, you actually have a liability.
